_: Written by `ci-video narrate`. Records which line each mp3 is a read of, in which voice, on which engine, at what prosody — so a later edit to any of those can be detected instead of silently keeping the old recording. Commit this with the mp3s.

open.text: Mentra glasses voice input, answered by the AI you run, and spoken back.

loop.text: Your voice becomes a response from the model you configure, and the answer is spoken back.

wire.text: You sign in with your Companion Intelligence account. Inference routes to your Companion Hub, or to Hermes and OpenClaw endpoints. Memory is optional.

close.text: Ask from your glasses with Companion for Mentra glasses. Visit mentra dot ci dot computer. UnCloud your life.
